provenance: Owner-approved progressive ordinary bot gold loot. Retains the 65% bot XP policy, existing pair window and repeat reductions. Human rewards, bounty escrow and Vault protection are unchanged.

gold.arithmetic: Exact BigInt 3% floor; bounded rational logarithm intervals agree on the integer floor; exact BigInt pair-percentage floor. No floating logarithm or replacement ceiling.

rounding: R=floor(exposed wallet*3/100). Apply progressive gold scaling, then floor the existing pair percentage. XP remains max(1,floor(full difficulty XP*65/100)), then max(1,floor(scaled full XP*pair percentage/100)).
transfer: Only the actual exposed wallet funds loot. Debit and credit the same amount transactionally; preserve the existing retained-credit journal when the destination spendable wallet is full. No wallet refill, protected-balance withdrawal or new gold.
history: Register this new immutable definition without altering v1/v2 definitions, balances, population, historical battles, financial ledgers, command receipts or pair windows. Existing encounter eligibility and autonomous-duel scheduling remain unchanged.
